name: Norway (Royal Standard)

colors.symbolism: the field of the royal arms

description: A red banner of the royal arms: a crowned golden lion rampant bearing an axe.
history: The Norwegian royal standard is a banner of the coat of arms of Norway — the crowned lion with St Olav's axe, a design traced to the 13th-century sverre dynasty kings. Readopted with the restoration of a separate Norwegian monarchy in 1905.

features.role: crowned lion rampant bearing an axe
features.symbolism: the lion of the medieval Norwegian kings; the axe is the martyr's axe of St Olav
